content.english: and beside me there is none that rescues. (Isaiah 43:11)

content.hebrew: אָֽנֹכִ֞י הִגַּ֤דְתִּי וְהוֹשַׁ֨עְתִּי֙ וְהִשְׁמַ֔עְתִּי וְאֵ֥ין בָּכֶ֖ם זָ֑ר
content.transliteration: Anochi higgadti vehosha‘ti vehishma‘ti ve’en bachem zar,
content.english: I have declared, and I have rescued, and I have announced, and there was no strange god among you;
therefore you are my witnesses, says Adonai, and I am God. (Isaiah 43:12)

content.hebrew: אַתֶּ֤ם עֵדַי֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְעַבְדִּ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחָ֑רְתִּי
content.transliteration: Attem ‘edai ne’um adonai ve‘avdi asher baḥarti,
content.english: You are my witnesses, says Adonai, and my servant whom I have chosen;

content.hebrew: *לְמַ֣עַן תֵּֽ֠דְעוּ וְתַֽאֲמִ֨ינוּ לִ֤י וְתָבִ֨ינוּ֙ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא לְפָנַי֙ לֹא־נ֣וֹצַר אֵ֔ל וְאַֽחֲרַ֖י לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶֽה׃
content.transliteration: *lema‘an tede‘u vetavinu ki ani hu lefanai lo notsar el ve’aḥarai lo yihyē.
content.english: that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he; before me there was no god formed, neither shall any be after me. (Isaiah 43:10)
But I am Adonai your God from the land of Egypt; I will yet again settle you in tents, as in the days of the appointed season. (Hosea 10:12)

content.hebrew: גַּם־מִיּוֹם֙ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא וְאֵ֥ין מִיָּדִ֖י מַצִּ֑יל
content.transliteration: Gam miyom ani hu ve’en miyadi mats-tsil,
content.english: Yea, since day existed, I have been he, and there is none that can deliver out of my hand; I will act, and who can reverse it? (Isaiah 43:13)

content.transliteration: Mi fa‘al ve‘asa ḳorē haddorot merosh,
content.english: Who has acted and done it? He that called the generations from the beginning.

content.transliteration: *ani adonai rishon ve’et aḥaronim ani hu.
content.english: I, Adonai, who am the first, and with the last I am the same. (Isaiah 41:4)
Yet I am the Adonai your God since the Land of Egypt;

content.hebrew: *וֵֽאלֹהִ֤ים זֽוּלָתִי֙ לֹ֣א תֵדָ֔ע וּמוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אַ֖יִן בִּלְתִּֽי׃
content.transliteration: *velohim zulati lo teda‘ umoshiya‘ ayin bilti.
content.english: *and you know no god but me, and beside me there is no saviour. (Hosea 13:4)

content.hebrew: אָֽנֹכִ֨י ׀ יְהֹ֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ הַֽ֭מַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם
content.transliteration: Anochi adonai elohecha hamma‘alcha me’erets mitsrayim,
content.english: I am Adonai your God, who brought you up out of the Land of Egypt; open your mouth wide, and I will fill it. (Psalms 81:11)

content.hebrew: שִׁמְעָ֤ה עַמִּ֨י ׀ וַאֲדַבֵּ֗רָה יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ
content.english: Listen, my people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will arraign you,

introduction:
Introduction

Name: אנכי אנכי, Anochi Anochi



Introduction:

This string of verses is recited before the ‘aliyya in which we read the Ten Commandments. The Ten Commandments begin with the Hebrew word אָנֹכִי (Anochi) (Exodus 20:2). In this string of verses, each verse contains the word אָנֹכִי  (Anochi), or, alternatively אֲנִי (Ani) in each verse. (Both words translate into English as the pronoun “I”.) We have colored this word in red in each verse. Several of the verses also mention that God has had a relationship with the Jewish people since the exodus from Egypt, another connection to the opening line of the Decalogue: “I am Adonai your God, who took you out of the Land of Egypt.”



Name: אנכי אנכי, Anochi Anochi

Category: Liturgy

Sub-Category: Biblical verses

Genre: Introduction to Torah-reading

Occasion: Shabbat Yitro, Shabbat Va’etḥannan

Composer: N/A (Biblical Verses)
